title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages. Men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.

title: Ondondu Kshana
desc: A CBI officer is hot on the trail of a ruthless serial killer who is disrupting the peace. However, her mission takes a dangerous turn when the murderer targets her and her family.

title: Amrithadhare
desc: Puru and Amritha are a married couple deeply in love with each other. However, they face challenges as they try to balance their conflicting desires in their marriage.

title: Maryade Ramanna
desc: With the hope of beginning anew, a man returns to his village to sell a piece of his land. On the way, he falls in love with a young woman, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.

title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.
